prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit paint_mask_guide.png as the exact spatial template; design_reference.png is material/detail reference and icon_x8.png is color reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta). Produce ONE transparent PNG 1536x2048 (3:4). Preserve exact guide silhouettes, positions, sizes, orientations, gaps and openings. Three columns by FOUR rows of 512px cells: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty, repeated identically below. Do not reinterpret view names or rearrange objects. Paint only existing grey objects. Object: source-faithful pair vertical cuffs-down Mail Gauntlets. Upper two rows: unlit base color, brown leather fingers and cuff with fine leather grain, steel chain mail panel over back of hand as reference; project consistent material detail across the supplied views. No lighting, shadows, AO, hot highlights, reflections. Lower two rows: corresponding same silhouettes with flat categorical material mask: metal/chain mail pure red #FF0000; leather and fur pure green #00FF00; cloth/hair pure blue #0000FF; gemstones/glass/enamel/liquid pure black #000000. Every interior silhouette pixel exactly one category; no shading, texture, outlines or blended mask colors. Chain mail region solid red material region, leather solid green; keep actual geometric holes transparent. Empty cells column 3 rows 2 and 4 fully transparent. No ground, text, labels, halo or extra objects. Never redraw/enlarge/move/redesign guide objects. Preserve transparent background. Follow design reference details scaled to each exact view.
CORRECTION, CRITICAL: Output must be 3:4 portrait, NOT a tall narrow sheet. Match the attached guide canvas exactly. Preserve ALL original grey object outlines exactly, including center hand's slightly tilted cuff and fingers. Lower half repeats upper half positions shifted exactly half canvas height. Mask surfaces must have NO finger outlines or creases, NO stray speckles outside silhouettes, NO filled wrist holes. Keep clean transparent gaps and clean transparent exterior. Use the guide as a locked paint-over template, not inspiration.
